name: Akita Inuzuka
source:
Akita Inuzuka is a member of Konohagakure's Inuzuka clan and a lead scientist for the Scientific Ninja Weapons Team. Akita is a young woman of average height and slender built with long dark-colored hair and eyes framed by glasses. She wears a black dress with a white lab coat over it and a choker around her neck. Her canine teeth appear to be elongated and she wears fang-shaped earrings. Akita is a passionate woman to anything close to her. While originally a field ninja, her greatest concern more than completing the mission was the wellbeing of her dog [url=https://vndb.org/c149780]Chamaru[/url].

[In game description]
